summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Laurean Rugambwa, a Roman Catholic cardinal. It states his birth and death dates and identifies him as the first modern native African cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church. It also records his tenure as Archbishop of Dar es Salaam and the year he was made a cardinal.
one_line: Laurean Rugambwa was the first modern native African Roman Catholic cardinal and served as Archbishop of Dar es Salaam.
key_facts: Laurean Rugambwa was born on July 12, 1912.
Laurean Rugambwa was the first modern native African Cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church.
Laurean Rugambwa served as Archbishop of Dar es Salaam from 1968 to 1992.
Laurean Rugambwa was elevated to the cardinalate in 1960.
